title: Man and Little Girl with Ice Cream at Park, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot captures a smiling man kneeling on the lawn beside a young girl enjoying an ice cream cone at a sunny outdoor gathering around 1960. The girl wears a patterned swimsuit and headband, while the man wears a button-down striped short-sleeve cabana shirt with a nametag, shorts, and sandals. In the background, patio umbrellas, shady trees, and fellow picnickers in lawn chairs highlight mid-century American outdoor suburban leisure.
